2.3.26 Report.LeftMargin
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Report.LeftMargin element specifies the width of the left margin of a Report. The
Report.LeftMargin element is optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be an RdlSize. If
this element is not present, its value is interpreted as "0in".
Following is the parent element of the Report.LeftMargin element.
Parent elements
Report
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Report.LeftMargin element.
 <xsd:element name="LeftMargin" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0" />
